ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 Customer shall not be liable for any liquidated damages or penalties under this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the late-payment liquidated damages charge of fifteen percent of annual Fees per week, which our playbook does not accept, and replaced it with a clear statement that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us. If a liquidated amount is unavoidable, we can accept a sole early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.
input.summary: Delete Customer-payable liquidated damages in § 7.7 and confirm no LDs or penalties payable by Customer.
